title: Maximum Subarray
description: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum using Kadane's algorithm.

data.text: Given an integer array `nums`, find the subarray (contiguous) with the largest sum and return its sum.
Try every start/end pair and sum the subarray. O(n³) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Brute Force O(n³)

data.text: At each element decide: extend the current subarray or start fresh. Keep the best sum seen. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Kadane O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n³) → O(n). **Space:** O(1) both ways. Kadane's trick is that adding a negative running sum only makes things worse — drop it and restart.

cards.title: Kadane's Algorithm
cards.description: Greedy running sum, restart when negative
